name: Yugyouji Nagisa
source:
Class 2, Grade 1, Fujitsubo Academy (held back one year).

He is Yoruko's older half-brother, but the two are not on good terms. He has a free-spirited and unruly personality, earning him a reputation as a troublesome figure at school. However, he is simply honest with his feelings, which leads to him being ostracized and looked down upon by those around him. He is a lone wolf and doesn't mix with others, but he has taken a liking to the protagonist.

Although he dotes on his sister in the library, she mostly ignores him. He is also very fond of the protagonist's younger sister, Kisaki, leading to rumors that he is an irredeemable siscon.

This rumor is so at odds with his intimidating public image that hardly anyone believes it. It seems he often skips school to work alongside Honjou Kanade, dealing with the magical books.

[Translated from [url=https://kagura.rdy.jp/kamimaho/character_nagisa.html]official website[/url]]
